strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『除了你之外,{NEWLINE}这里所有人都是我的手下败将。{CLEAR}只要能在这里把你打败,{CLEAR}从世界上消失的就是你们火箭队！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Except for you, I’ve beaten{NEWLINE}everyone here.{SCROLL}If I beat you here and now, it’s Team{NEWLINE}Rocket that will disappear from this{CLEAR}world!

strings.zh: 坂木『论人数和财力,{NEWLINE}火箭队都不及精灵联盟。{CLEAR}但即便如此,{CLEAR}我们仍然敢站出来挑战精灵联盟,{CLEAR}就是因为有我这个{CLEAR}天下无敌的训练家在。{SCROLL}坂木『你如果能打败我,{NEWLINE}那我们火箭队干脆原地解散算了。
strings.en: Giovanni: In numbers and in money, Team{NEWLINE}Rocket can’t match the Pokémon League.{SCROLL}Even so, we dare to stand up and{NEWLINE}challenge the League...{SCROLL}because we have me, a Trainer no one{NEWLINE}can beat.{SCROLL}Giovanni: If you can beat me, Team{NEWLINE}Rocket might as well disband on the{CLEAR}spot.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那我今天{NEWLINE}更是非打败你不可了！{CLEAR}不是作为向馆主挑战打败你,{CLEAR}而是为了关东的人们和精灵{CLEAR}打败火箭队的首领！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then I really have to beat you{NEWLINE}today!{SCROLL}Not to beat you as a Gym challenger...{SCROLL}but to defeat the boss of Team Rocket{NEWLINE}for the people and Pokémon of Kanto!

strings.zh: 坂木『哼哼,虽然天真无知,{NEWLINE}但也勇气可嘉。{SCROLL}坂木『既然如此,我就给你一个{NEWLINE}活着从这里走出去的机会。{CLEAR}你只要能打败我手上的3只精灵,{CLEAR}我就让你带着我双重身份的秘密,{CLEAR}从常磐道馆活着走出去。{SCROLL}坂木『如果你输了,{NEWLINE}要么加入我们火箭队,{CLEAR}要么就给我死在这里。
strings.en: Giovanni: Heh heh. Naive and foolish, but{NEWLINE}brave, I’ll give you that.{SCROLL}Giovanni: Very well. I’ll give you a{NEWLINE}chance to walk out of here alive.{SCROLL}Defeat my 3 Pokémon, and you may leave{NEWLINE}the Viridian Gym alive...{SCROLL}carrying the secret of my double life{NEWLINE}with you.{SCROLL}Giovanni: If you lose, you either join{NEWLINE}Team Rocket... or die right here.

strings.zh: 坂木『我……输了！？{NEWLINE}「最强」的我……{CLEAR}从来没有战败过的我……{CLEAR}输了……
strings.en: Giovanni: I... lost!? I, the{NEWLINE}Strongest... I, who have never been{CLEAR}defeated... lost...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哈……哈哈……{NEWLINE}呼……呼……没错,是我赢了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ha... ha ha... *pant*...{NEWLINE}*pant*... That’s right, I won!

strings.zh: 阿波罗『老大,这小鬼的精灵{NEWLINE}没有多少体力了,{CLEAR}请允许我给他最后一击！
strings.en: Archer: Boss, this brat’s Pokémon have{NEWLINE}almost no HP left. Let me finish the{CLEAR}brat off!
strings.notes: | RV053: addressee: 他 for a player who may be female, no gender branch; neutral per D-1224 (D-1834)

strings.zh: 坂木『不,阿波罗……
strings.en: Giovanni: No, Archer...

strings.zh: 坂木『你赢的很漂亮。{NEWLINE}在刚才跟你的战斗中,{CLEAR}我居然久违地体会到了{CLEAR}精灵对战的乐趣。{CLEAR}能让我产生这种感觉,{CLEAR}你真是个了不起的训练家。{SCROLL}坂木『这是常磐道馆的绿色徽章,{NEWLINE}你收下吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: That was a fine win.{SCROLL}In our battle just now, for the first{NEWLINE}time in a long while, I actually enjoyed{CLEAR}a Pokémon battle.{SCROLL}Any Trainer who can make me feel that is{NEWLINE}remarkable indeed.{SCROLL}Giovanni: This is the Viridian Gym’s{NEWLINE}Earth Badge. Take it.
{VAR:0103:0}: I don’t want it!

strings.zh: 坂木『嗯？为什么？
strings.en: Giovanni: Hm? Why not?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我不需要{NEWLINE}火箭队老大给的徽章。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t need a Badge from the{NEWLINE}boss of Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 坂木『哼,真会刺激我的神经。
strings.en: Giovanni: Hmph. You really know how to{NEWLINE}get under my skin.

strings.zh: 坂木『阿波罗,向所有火箭队员传达。{NEWLINE}火箭队从现在起就地解散。{CLEAR}各队员按计划回归原本的身份。
strings.en: Giovanni: Archer, tell every member of{NEWLINE}Team Rocket...{SCROLL}Team Rocket is disbanded, effective{NEWLINE}now. All members return to their former{CLEAR}identities as planned.

strings.zh: 阿波罗『老大！您这是干什么！{NEWLINE}现在火箭队声势正壮,{CLEAR}完全没必要紧急解散啊！
strings.en: Archer: Boss! What are you doing!{SCROLL}Team Rocket is stronger than ever right{NEWLINE}now. There’s no need to disband in a{CLEAR}hurry!

strings.zh: 坂木『今天这场战斗是我输了。{NEWLINE}按照跟这个小鬼的约定,{CLEAR}他可以活着离开这里,{CLEAR}那么世人也即将知道{CLEAR}我火箭队首领的身份。{SCROLL}坂木『我的身份暴露后,{NEWLINE}火箭队必将与精灵联盟正面冲突,{CLEAR}为了避免这场准备不足的战斗,{CLEAR}火箭队必须按计划进行解散潜伏。
strings.en: Giovanni: I lost today’s battle. As I{NEWLINE}promised this brat, the brat may leave{CLEAR}here alive.{SCROLL}Then the world will soon know that I am{NEWLINE}the boss of Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Giovanni: Once my identity is out, Team{NEWLINE}Rocket will go head to head with the{CLEAR}Pokémon League.{SCROLL}To avoid a battle we’re not ready for,{NEWLINE}Team Rocket must disband and go{CLEAR}underground as planned.

strings.zh: 阿波罗『可是老大,咱们完全没必要{NEWLINE}让这个小鬼活着出去啊。
strings.en: Archer: But Boss, there’s no need to{NEWLINE}let this brat walk out of here alive.

strings.zh: 阿波罗『老大！！！
strings.en: Archer: Boss!!!

strings.zh: 坂木『阿波罗、乔伊,{NEWLINE}成大事者当知一诺千金。{CLEAR}你们按我的意思{CLEAR}向全体队员下达命令吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: Archer. Joy. Anyone who would{NEWLINE}do great things must keep his word.{SCROLL}Give the order to all members, as I’ve{NEWLINE}told you.

strings.zh: 乔伊『坂木老大,{NEWLINE}阿波罗大人说的有道理,{CLEAR}这个小鬼不能留啊。
strings.en: Joy: Boss Giovanni, Lord Archer is{NEWLINE}right. We can’t let this brat live.
strings.notes: 乔伊 here = Rocket Elite Joy (0719). | 乔伊 here = Rocket Elite Joy (0719).

strings.zh: 坂木馆主就在前面,{NEWLINE}请过去吧！
strings.en: Gym Leader Giovanni is just ahead.{NEWLINE}Please, go on through!

strings.zh: 坂木『我既然跟这个小鬼{NEWLINE}定下了战斗赌约,{CLEAR}又岂能在输了之后赖账呢。
strings.en: Giovanni: I made a bet on this battle{NEWLINE}with the brat. How could I go back on it{CLEAR}now that I’ve lost?

strings.zh: 阿波罗『那咱们就在{NEWLINE}放他离开道馆门的一瞬间干掉他,{CLEAR}这样既不违背赌约{CLEAR}又能守住咱们的秘密。
strings.en: Archer: Then we’ll take him out the{NEWLINE}moment he steps out of the Gym door.{SCROLL}That way we don’t break the bet, and{NEWLINE}our secret stays safe.

strings.zh: 武藏、小次郎、喵喵『坂木老大……
strings.en: Jessie, James & Meowth: Boss Giovanni...

strings.zh: 坂木『我坚守身为训练家的尊严,{NEWLINE}不惜临时解散火箭队{CLEAR}也要执行与你之间的赌约,{CLEAR}你现在认可这枚徽章了吧？
strings.en: Giovanni: I held on to my pride as a{NEWLINE}Trainer.{SCROLL}I even disbanded Team Rocket for now,{NEWLINE}just to keep my bet with you.{SCROLL}Now will you accept this Badge?

strings.zh: 坂木『你们就好好享受{NEWLINE}火箭队解散的这段时光吧,{CLEAR}总有一天我们会回来的。{SCROLL}坂木『期待下次再见面时,{NEWLINE}能跟你来一场赌上「最强」之名的战斗。
strings.en: Giovanni: Enjoy your time while Team{NEWLINE}Rocket is disbanded. One day, we will{CLEAR}return.{SCROLL}Giovanni: I look forward to our next{NEWLINE}meeting, and a battle with the title of{CLEAR}Strongest at stake.

strings.zh: 金婆婆『坂木老弟你不能这么办事啊！
strings.en: Granny Kin: Giovanni, dear boy, you{NEWLINE}can’t handle it like this!
strings.notes: 金婆婆 → Granny Kin (Rocket financier; elsewhere ends lines with 婆婆). Invented name. | 金婆婆 → Granny Kin (Rocket financier; elsewhere ends lines with 婆婆). Invented name.

strings.zh: 你是来挑战坂木馆主的吧？{NEWLINE}能见到我说明你拥有高尚的品德,{CLEAR}不过要见馆主只有品德是不够的。{CLEAR}你只有回答对了我的问题,{CLEAR}展现出足够的智慧,{CLEAR}才有资格去跟坂木馆主对话。{SCROLL}那么,现在要开始答题吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: You’re here to challenge Gym Leader{NEWLINE}Giovanni, aren’t you? If you’ve reached{CLEAR}me, you have fine virtue.{SCROLL}But virtue alone isn’t enough to meet{NEWLINE}the Gym Leader.{SCROLL}Only if you answer my questions{NEWLINE}correctly and show enough wisdom...{SCROLL}may you speak with Gym Leader Giovanni.{SCROLL}So, shall we begin the questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 做好准备的话就跟我说吧。
strings.en: Tell me when you’re ready.

strings.zh: 无视假大空的宣传口号说出真话,{NEWLINE}你跟我们一样具备真正的智慧。{CLEAR}你有资格去见坂木大人了！

strings.zh: 小刚『那么,恭喜你小绿。{NEWLINE}你现在正式成为常磐道馆的馆主了。

{VAR:0103:0}: Well...{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: Okay...

strings.zh: 小刚『不过关东地区的馆主考核{NEWLINE}还没有结束,{CLEAR}我马上要去华蓝市{CLEAR}主持华蓝道馆的馆主考核。{SCROLL}小刚『你如果对这里的落选感到失望,{NEWLINE}去竞争华蓝道馆的馆主也不错。{CLEAR}以你的实力肯定是无人能挡。
strings.en: Brock: But the Gym Leader assessments{NEWLINE}in Kanto aren’t over yet.{SCROLL}I’m heading to Cerulean City right now{NEWLINE}to run the assessment for the Cerulean{CLEAR}Gym.{SCROLL}Brock: If you’re disappointed about{NEWLINE}missing out here, you could try for{CLEAR}Cerulean Gym Leader.{SCROLL}With your skills, nobody could stop you.

strings.zh: 小绿『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}你还真是个爱迟到的家伙。{CLEAR}我本来都制定好了专门打败你的战术,{CLEAR}结果却被你给躲过去了。

strings.zh: 小绿『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}我本来在考核中{CLEAR}再跟你来一场堂堂正正的决斗,{CLEAR}没成想却以这种方式宣告结束。

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Heh heh. I guess it’s fate.{SCROLL}Come to think of it, I’m not really the{NEWLINE}type to stay in a Gym and train.{SCROLL}Free and easy training on the road{NEWLINE}suits me better.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你现在作为道馆馆主,{NEWLINE}可是肩负着整个城市的安危。{CLEAR}加油啊！

strings.en: Blue: Well...{SCROLL}Blue: Don’t you worry. I’ll do a better{NEWLINE}job than you do as League Champion!
